use_cases: Primary call-to-action buttons on landing pages and marketing sites
Navigation triggers with directional arrow affordance
Interactive form submission buttons with visual feedback
404 page navigation returning users to valid pages
Reusable button component in component systems and design tokens
ai_summary: A minimalist ghost-style button component featuring smooth hover animations where a circular background expands from center, arrows slide in/out, and text repositions. The component uses sophisticated cubic-bezier easing for fluid motion, with an active state scale effect. Designed as a versatile interactive element commonly paired with 404 pages and landing page CTAs.
